entries.body:
Rounds 1-3 of 10 released. Round 4 is released but not yet read; step 11 output is pending. Rounds 5-10 are still to come.

Log format: `<ISO ts> LEVEL  <service> <msg> key=val`. "slow query ms=..." WARNs are noise. Notes are in /task/workspace/notes.md.

Changes:
- round-01/changes.md:3 CHG-109 PROPOSED: HPA search tier.
- round-01/changes.md:4 CHG-113 APPLIED: build 4.16.4 to search-api, sets http.max_inflight=-1. Possible BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT; no search-api errors so far.
- round-01/changes.md:5 CHG-114 APPLIED: 4.16.4 to checkout-api, no config change.
- round-02/changes.md:3 CHG-117 PROPOSED: batch jobs to off-peak.
- round-03/changes.md:3 CHG-125 APPLIED: retry budget for idempotent GETs set to 1.

Thread A: CERT_EXPIRED (peer=sso.example.net).
- Services: ledger-svc, inventory-svc.
- Status: ongoing, set by round-02/board.md:3. Round-03 board was empty.
- Evidence:
  - round-01/logs/ledger-svc.log:14-40
  - round-02/logs/ledger-svc.log:20-28
  - round-02/logs/inventory-svc.log:10-26
  - round-03/logs/inventory-svc.log:9-18
  - round-03/logs/ledger-svc.log:23-43

Follow-ups: none yet.

Next: read round 4 (board has 8 lines), then advance to round 10, tracking causes, statuses, follow-ups and refs.
